```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'here' is required. Install it with install.packages('here').")
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

This script reproduces the complete 2025 eddy-covariance processing workflow.
All repository inputs use project-relative paths. Completed manual-review decision
files are treated as permanent inputs and are never overwritten by this script.

```{r process_2025}

# ============================================================
# EC Compare (LD vs MD) — 2025 10% SPIKE CLEAN REWRITE
# ============================================================
# Purpose:
#   - read EddyPro full_output for LD and MD
#   - read LD biomet and Grant envwx fallback drivers
#   - apply dynamic NEE screening and four-stage manual review
#   - build REddyProc input tables
#   - run REddyProc for LD and MD
#   - build daily / monthly outputs
#   - estimate LD soil heat storage + energy balance closure
#
# Main fixes vs prior script:
#   - build_rp_drivers() now uses bio_drivers columns: Rg, Tair, RH, P
#   - duplicate manual rp_drivers block removed
#   - signal_strength handled safely if missing
#   - winter negative and winter positive review aligned with 2023/2024
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(REddyProc)
  library(zoo)
  library(here)
})

# ----------------------------
# 0) ANALYSIS SETTINGS
# ----------------------------
year_use <- 2025
tz_site  <- "America/Toronto"
run_tag  <- "10spike"

# Repository root is detected from the .Rproj or .git directory.
repo_root <- here::here()


LatDeg       <- 42.9
LongDeg      <- -85.1
TimeZoneHour <- -5

# LD orchard sector to KEEP
fetch_keep_min <- 90
fetch_keep_max <- 315

# Growing season
gs_start <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-04-15", year_use))
gs_end   <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-10-31", year_use))

# Dynamic screening settings
night_rg_thr <- 10
transition_rg_thr <- 50

nee_max_global <- 80
winter_neg_night_remove <- -5
winter_pos_night_review <- 12
ustar_review_thr <- 0.10

# physically based low-NEE artifact screen
nee_extreme_cutoff <- -120
rg_low_cutoff      <- 100
ustar_low_cutoff   <- 0.25

# Winter cleanup before REddyProc
winter_months <- c(11, 12, 1, 2)
nee_winter_night_pos_cap <- 6

# REddyProc settings
sw_thr <- 10
n_boot <- 100L
probs  <- c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95)
scen_use <- "U50"

# Coverage / reporting
min_coverage <- 0.70
min_frac_Rg_daily <- 0.75

# Sentinel values
sentinel <- c(-9999, -9999.0, -6999, -7999, -8888, 6999, 7999, 9999, -19998, 19998)

# Gstorage / energy balance
z_plate_m     <- 0.05
rho_b         <- 1300
cp_solid      <- 800
rho_w         <- 1000
cp_w          <- 4186
max_abs_Gstor <- 200

# Plot colors
okabe_ito <- c(
  orange    = "#E69F00",
  skyblue   = "#56B4E9",
  green     = "#009E73",
  yellow    = "#F0E442",
  blue      = "#0072B2",
  vermilion = "#D55E00",
  purple    = "#CC79A7",
  black     = "#000000"
)

flux_colors <- c(
  GPP  = okabe_ito["green"],
  Reco = okabe_ito["orange"],
  NEE  = okabe_ito["blue"]
)

site_cols <- c(
  LD = okabe_ito["vermilion"],
  MD = okabe_ito["blue"]
)

# ----------------------------
# 1) REPOSITORY INPUT / OUTPUT PATHS
# ----------------------------

# Raw 2025 files are stored under data/raw/2025.
year_dir <- here::here("data", "raw", as.character(year_use))
ld_dir <- file.path(year_dir, "low-density_10spike")
md_dir <- file.path(year_dir, "moderate-density_10spike")
grant_path <- file.path(year_dir, "envwx_2025.csv")

# Completed manual-review files are version-controlled analysis inputs.
manual_review_root <- here::here(
  "data", "manual_review", as.character(year_use)
)

high_positive_review_dir <- file.path(
  manual_review_root,
  paste0("HighPositiveReview_", year_use)
)

large_negative_review_dir <- file.path(
  manual_review_root,
  paste0("LargeNegativeReview_", year_use)
)

winter_negative_review_dir <- file.path(
  manual_review_root,
  paste0("WinterNegativeReview_", year_use)
)

winter_positive_review_dir <- file.path(
  manual_review_root,
  paste0("WinterPositiveReview_", year_use)
)

# Generated processing outputs.
out_dir <- here::here("data", "processed", as.character(year_use))
manual_review_diagnostic_root <- file.path(
  out_dir, "manual_review_diagnostics"
)

# Generated diagnostic figures. Manuscript figures will be made later by a
# separate publication-figure script.
diagnostic_figure_dir <- here::here(
  "figures", "processing_diagnostics", as.character(year_use)
)

for (dd in c(
  out_dir,
  file.path(out_dir, "LD"),
  file.path(out_dir, "MD"),
  file.path(out_dir, "compare"),
  manual_review_diagnostic_root,
  file.path(diagnostic_figure_dir, "LD"),
  file.path(diagnostic_figure_dir, "compare")
)) {
  dir.create(dd, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Required completed decision files.
manual_decision_paths <- c(
  HighPositive = file.path(
    high_positive_review_dir,
    paste0("HighPositiveReview_manual_decisions_TEMPLATE_", year_use, ".csv")
  ),
  LargeNegative = file.path(
    large_negative_review_dir,
    paste0("LargeNegativeReview_manual_decisions_TEMPLATE_", year_use, ".csv")
  ),
  WinterNegative = file.path(
    winter_negative_review_dir,
    paste0("WinterNegativeReview_manual_decisions_TEMPLATE_", year_use, ".csv")
  ),
  WinterPositive = file.path(
    winter_positive_review_dir,
    paste0("WinterPositiveReview_manual_decisions_TEMPLATE_", year_use, ".csv")
  )
)

required_dirs <- c(ld_dir, md_dir)
missing_dirs <- required_dirs[!dir.exists(required_dirs)]

if (length(missing_dirs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required 2025 raw-data folder(s):\n",
    paste(missing_dirs, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

required_files <- c(grant_path, unname(manual_decision_paths))
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required 2025 input file(s):\n",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

analysis_parameters <- tibble::tribble(
  ~parameter, ~value,
  "year", as.character(year_use),
  "timezone", tz_site,
  "run_tag", run_tag,
  "latitude_degrees", as.character(LatDeg),
  "longitude_degrees", as.character(LongDeg),
  "timezone_hour", as.character(TimeZoneHour),
  "LD_fetch_keep_min_degrees", as.character(fetch_keep_min),
  "LD_fetch_keep_max_degrees", as.character(fetch_keep_max),
  "growing_season_start", as.character(gs_start),
  "growing_season_end", as.character(gs_end),
  "night_Rg_threshold_W_m2", as.character(night_rg_thr),
  "transition_Rg_threshold_W_m2", as.character(transition_rg_thr),
  "global_NEE_max_umol_m2_s", as.character(nee_max_global),
  "winter_negative_review_threshold_umol_m2_s", as.character(winter_neg_night_remove),
  "winter_positive_review_threshold_umol_m2_s", as.character(winter_pos_night_review),
  "uStar_review_threshold_m_s", as.character(ustar_review_thr),
  "REddyProc_bootstrap_iterations", as.character(n_boot),
  "REddyProc_scenario_used", scen_use,
  "minimum_reporting_coverage", as.character(min_coverage),
  "minimum_daily_Rg_fraction", as.character(min_frac_Rg_daily)
)

write_csv(
  analysis_parameters,
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("Analysis_parameters_", year_use, ".csv"))
)

# ============================================================
# 2) HELPERS
# ============================================================
need_cols <- function(df, cols, label = "df") {
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss)) stop(label, " missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

norm_time <- function(tt) {
  tt <- str_trim(as.character(tt))
  str_replace(tt, "^([0-9]):", "0\\1:")
}

detect_delim <- function(line) {
  if (str_count(line, fixed("\t")) > str_count(line, fixed(","))) "\t" else ","
}

coerce_numeric_and_sentinel_to_na <- function(df, keep_cols = "DateTime") {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(-all_of(keep_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
    mutate(across(-all_of(keep_cols), ~ ifelse(.x %in% sentinel, NA_real_, .x)))
}

collapse_duplicates <- function(df) {
  stopifnot("DateTime" %in% names(df))
  df %>%
    group_by(DateTime) %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        everything(),
        ~{
          if (cur_column() == "DateTime") {
            first(.x)
          } else {
            x <- .x[!is.na(.x)]
            if (length(x) == 0) NA else x[1]
          }
        }
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(DateTime)
}

full_output_files <- function(dir_path) {
  list.files(
    dir_path,
    pattern = "full_output.*\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}

parse_dt_date_time <- function(date_vec, time_vec, tz = tz_site) {
  date_chr <- str_trim(as.character(date_vec))
  time_chr <- norm_time(time_vec)
  dt_chr   <- paste(date_chr, time_chr)

  dt <- suppressWarnings(mdy_hm(dt_chr, tz = tz))
  if (all(is.na(dt))) dt <- suppressWarnings(ymd_hm(dt_chr, tz = tz))
  if (all(is.na(dt))) {
    dt <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
      dt_chr,
      orders = c("mdy HM", "mdy HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd HMS", "dmy HM", "dmy HMS"),
      tz = tz
    ))
  }
  floor_date(dt, "30 minutes")
}

# Parse manual-review timestamps without shifting Eastern local times.
parse_review_datetime <- function(x, tz = tz_site) {

  # readr may already have parsed the CSV column as POSIXct.
  # Preserve the absolute instant and display it in local site time.
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {
    return(lubridate::with_tz(x, tzone = tz))
  }

  x_chr <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(x))

  has_explicit_zone <- stringr::str_detect(
    x_chr,
    "Z$|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2}$"
  )

  out <- as.POSIXct(
    rep(NA_real_, length(x_chr)),
    origin = "1970-01-01",
    tz = tz
  )

  # ISO values ending in Z or an offset are absolute UTC times.
  if (any(has_explicit_zone)) {
    parsed_utc <- suppressWarnings(
      lubridate::ymd_hms(
        x_chr[has_explicit_zone],
        tz = "UTC",
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )

    out[has_explicit_zone] <- lubridate::with_tz(
      parsed_utc,
      tzone = tz
    )
  }

  # Values without a timezone are treated as orchard local time.
  if (any(!has_explicit_zone)) {
    parsed_local <- suppressWarnings(
      lubridate::parse_date_time(
        x_chr[!has_explicit_zone],
        orders = c(
          "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd",
          "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy",
          "dmy HMS", "dmy HM", "dmy"
        ),
        tz = tz
      )
    )

    out[!has_explicit_zone] <- parsed_local
  }

  out
}

make_full_year_time <- function(year, tz = tz_site) {
  start <- as.POSIXct(sprintf("%d-01-01 00:30:00", year), tz = tz)
  end_excl <- as.POSIXct(sprintf("%d-01-01 00:00:00", year + 1), tz = tz)
  tibble(DateTime = seq(from = start, to = end_excl - minutes(30), by = "30 min"))
}

K_to_C_if_needed <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  med <- suppressWarnings(median(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (is.finite(med) && med > 150) x - 273.15 else x
}

Pa_to_kPa_if_needed <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  med <- suppressWarnings(median(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (is.finite(med) && med > 50) x / 1000 else x
}

calc_vpd_kPa <- function(Tair_C, RH_pct) {
  Tair_C <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Tair_C))
  RH_pct <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(RH_pct))
  med_rh <- suppressWarnings(median(RH_pct, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (is.finite(med_rh) && med_rh <= 1.5) RH_pct <- RH_pct * 100
  RH_pct[RH_pct < 0 | RH_pct > 100] <- NA_real_

  es <- 0.6108 * exp((17.27 * Tair_C) / (Tair_C + 237.3))
  ea <- es * (RH_pct / 100)
  vpd <- es - ea
  vpd[vpd < 0 | vpd > 8] <- NA_real_
  vpd
}

esat_hPa <- function(Tair_C) 6.112 * exp((17.67 * Tair_C) / (Tair_C + 243.5))

vpd_from_tair_rh_hPa <- function(Tair_C, RH_pct) {
  T  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Tair_C))
  RH <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(RH_pct))
  out <- esat_hPa(T) * (1 - RH / 100)
  out[!is.finite(out) | out < 0] <- NA_real_
  out
}

safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
safe_sum  <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else sum(x,  na.rm = TRUE)
safe_max  <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x,  na.rm = TRUE)
safe_min  <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else min(x,  na.rm = TRUE)

umolco2_to_gC_hh <- function(x_umol_m2_s, seconds = 1800) {
  x_umol_m2_s * 12e-6 * seconds
}

# ============================================================
# 3) READERS
# ============================================================
read_full_output <- function(path, tz = tz_site) {
  l2 <- read_lines(path, n_max = 2)[2]
  delim <- detect_delim(l2)

  nm <- strsplit(l2, split = delim, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  nm <- make.names(nm, unique = TRUE)

  df <- read_delim(
    file = path,
    delim = delim,
    skip = 2,
    col_names = FALSE,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
  )

  df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  names(df) <- nm

  nms_low <- tolower(names(df))
  date_col <- names(df)[match(TRUE, nms_low %in% "date")]
  time_col <- names(df)[match(TRUE, nms_low %in% "time")]

  if (is.na(date_col) || is.na(time_col)) {
    stop("full_output missing date/time in: ", basename(path))
  }

  sig_col <- names(df)[grepl("rssi|signal.*strength", tolower(names(df)))][1]

  df %>%
    mutate(DateTime = parse_dt_date_time(.data[[date_col]], .data[[time_col]], tz = tz)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(DateTime)) %>%
    transmute(
      DateTime,
      co2_flux          = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["co2_flux"]])),
      co2_strg          = if ("co2_strg" %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["co2_strg"]])) else NA_real_,
      qc_co2_flux       = if ("qc_co2_flux" %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["qc_co2_flux"]])) else NA_real_,
      rand_err_co2_flux = if ("rand_err_co2_flux" %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["rand_err_co2_flux"]])) else NA_real_,
      H                 = if ("H" %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["H"]])) else NA_real_,
      LE                = if ("LE" %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["LE"]])) else NA_real_,
      ustar             = if ("u." %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["u."]])) else if ("Ustar" %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["Ustar"]])) else NA_real_,
      wind_dir          = if ("wind_dir" %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["wind_dir"]])) else NA_real_,
      VPD_Pa            = if ("VPD" %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["VPD"]])) else NA_real_,
      signal_strength   = if (!is.na(sig_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[sig_col]])) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    coerce_numeric_and_sentinel_to_na(keep_cols = "DateTime")
}

read_biomet_halfhour <- function(path, tz = tz_site) {
  lines <- read_lines(path, n_max = 3)
  delim <- detect_delim(lines[1])

  header_vec <- strsplit(lines[1], split = delim, fixed = TRUE)[[1]] %>% str_trim()
  nm <- make.names(header_vec, unique = TRUE)

  df <- read_delim(
    file = path,
    delim = delim,
    skip = 1,
    col_names = FALSE,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE,
    trim_ws = TRUE
  )

  df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  names(df) <- nm

  if (all(c("TIMESTAMP_1", "TIMESTAMP_2") %in% names(df))) {
    dt_chr <- paste(str_trim(df$TIMESTAMP_1), str_trim(df$TIMESTAMP_2))
    dt <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
      dt_chr,
      orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "dmy HMS", "dmy HM"),
      tz = tz
    ))
  } else {
    nms_low <- tolower(names(df))
    date_col <- names(df)[match(TRUE, grepl("date", nms_low))]
    time_col <- names(df)[match(TRUE, grepl("time", nms_low))]
    if (is.na(date_col) || is.na(time_col)) {
      print(names(df))
      stop("Biomet missing date/time in: ", basename(path))
    }
    dt <- parse_dt_date_time(df[[date_col]], df[[time_col]], tz = tz)
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(DateTime = floor_date(dt, "30 minutes")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(DateTime)) %>%
    coerce_numeric_and_sentinel_to_na(keep_cols = "DateTime") %>%
    arrange(DateTime)
}

read_envwx_grant <- function(path, tz = tz_site) {
  lines <- read_lines(path)

  hdr_idx <- which(
    grepl("\\bdate\\b", tolower(lines)) &
      grepl("\\btime\\b", tolower(lines)) &
      grepl("\\batmp\\b|\\bair\\s*temp\\b|\\btemperature\\b", tolower(lines))
  )[1]
  if (is.na(hdr_idx)) hdr_idx <- 1

  x <- read_csv(
    path,
    skip = hdr_idx - 1,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(trimws(.x))) %>%
    select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))

  if ("date" %in% names(x)) x <- x %>% filter(grepl("[0-9]", .data$date))

  to_num <- function(v, trace_to_zero = TRUE) {
    v <- str_trim(as.character(v))
    v[v %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "M", "m")] <- NA_character_
    if (trace_to_zero) v[v %in% c("T", "t", "trace", "TRACE")] <- "0"
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  }

  solar_to_Wm2_if_needed_local <- function(v) {
    v <- to_num(v, trace_to_zero = FALSE)
    mx <- suppressWarnings(max(v, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.finite(mx) && mx > 1500) v * (1000 / 3600) else v
  }

  nms <- names(x)
  pick1 <- function(patterns) {
    idx <- which(map_lgl(nms, ~ any(str_detect(.x, patterns))))
    if (length(idx) == 0) NA_character_ else nms[idx[1]]
  }

  c_date <- if ("date" %in% nms) "date" else pick1(c("^date$", "day"))
  c_time <- if ("time" %in% nms) "time" else pick1(c("^time$", "hour"))
  c_atmp <- if ("atmp" %in% nms) "atmp" else pick1(c("atmp", "air.?temp", "temperature"))
  c_relh <- if ("relh" %in% nms) "relh" else pick1(c("relh", "rh"))
  c_srad <- if ("srad" %in% nms) "srad" else pick1(c("srad", "solar", "rad"))
  c_pcpn <- if ("pcpn" %in% nms) "pcpn" else pick1(c("pcpn", "precip", "rain"))

  dt_chr <- paste(str_trim(x[[c_date]]), norm_time(x[[c_time]]))
  dt <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
    dt_chr,
    orders = c("mdy HM", "mdy HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd HMS", "dmy HM", "dmy HMS"),
    tz = tz
  ))

  tibble(
    DateTime   = floor_date(dt, "hour"),
    Tair_env_C = to_num(x[[c_atmp]], trace_to_zero = FALSE),
    RH_env_pct = if (!is.na(c_relh)) to_num(x[[c_relh]], trace_to_zero = FALSE) else NA_real_,
    Rg_env_Wm2 = if (!is.na(c_srad)) solar_to_Wm2_if_needed_local(x[[c_srad]]) else NA_real_,
    pcpn_mm_hr = if (!is.na(c_pcpn)) to_num(x[[c_pcpn]], trace_to_zero = TRUE) else NA_real_
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(DateTime)) %>%
    distinct(DateTime, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(DateTime) %>%
    mutate(VPD_env_kPa = calc_vpd_kPa(Tair_env_C, RH_env_pct))
}

make_envwx_halfhour <- function(envwx_hourly) {
  need_cols(envwx_hourly, c("DateTime","Rg_env_Wm2","Tair_env_C","RH_env_pct","pcpn_mm_hr","VPD_env_kPa"), "envwx_hourly")
  bind_rows(
    envwx_hourly %>% transmute(
      DateTime,
      Rg_env_Wm2, Tair_env_C, RH_env_pct, VPD_env_kPa,
      pcpn_mm_30min = pcpn_mm_hr / 2
    ),
    envwx_hourly %>% transmute(
      DateTime = DateTime + minutes(30),
      Rg_env_Wm2, Tair_env_C, RH_env_pct, VPD_env_kPa,
      pcpn_mm_30min = pcpn_mm_hr / 2
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(DateTime) %>%
    distinct(DateTime, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# ============================================================
# 4) BIOMET QC + SOIL AGGREGATION
# ============================================================
qc_rules <- tibble::tribble(
  ~col,        ~rule,          ~start,                       ~end,
  "SHF_2_1_1", "bad_after",    sprintf("%d-05-15", year_use), NA,
  "SHF_1_1_1", "bad_after",    sprintf("%d-10-13", year_use), NA,
  "SHF_3_1_1", "bad_all_year", NA,                            NA,
  "TS_2_1_1",  "bad_after",    sprintf("%d-08-02", year_use), NA,
  "SWC_1_1_1", "bad_between",  sprintf("%d-05-11", year_use), sprintf("%d-06-18", year_use)
)

apply_qc_rules <- function(df, qc_rules_tbl, tz = tz_site) {
  rules <- qc_rules_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      start_dt = ifelse(is.na(start), NA_character_, paste0(start, " 00:00:00")),
      end_dt   = ifelse(is.na(end),   NA_character_, paste0(end,   " 23:59:59")),
      start_dt = as.POSIXct(start_dt, tz = tz),
      end_dt   = as.POSIXct(end_dt, tz = tz)
    )

  out <- df
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rules))) {
    col_i  <- rules$col[i]
    rule_i <- rules$rule[i]
    sdt    <- rules$start_dt[i]
    edt    <- rules$end_dt[i]
    if (!col_i %in% names(out)) next

    if (rule_i == "bad_all_year") {
      out[[col_i]] <- NA_real_
    } else if (rule_i == "bad_after" && !is.na(sdt)) {
      out[[col_i]] <- ifelse(out$DateTime >= sdt, NA_real_, out[[col_i]])
    } else if (rule_i == "bad_before" && !is.na(sdt)) {
      out[[col_i]] <- ifelse(out$DateTime <= sdt, NA_real_, out[[col_i]])
    } else if (rule_i == "bad_between" && !is.na(sdt) && !is.na(edt)) {
      out[[col_i]] <- ifelse(out$DateTime >= sdt & out$DateTime <= edt, NA_real_, out[[col_i]])
    }
  }
  out
}

range_screen_biomet <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      across(matches("^SWC_"), ~ ifelse(!is.na(.x) & (.x < 0 | .x > 0.8), NA_real_, .x)),
      across(matches("^TS_"),  ~ ifelse(!is.na(.x) & (.x < 230 | .x > 330), NA_real_, .x)),
      across(matches("^SHF_"), ~ ifelse(!is.na(.x) & (abs(.x) > 300), NA_real_, .x))
    )
}

aggregate_soil_probes <- function(df) {
  shf_cols <- grep("^SHF_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  ts_cols  <- grep("^TS_",  names(df), value = TRUE)
  swc_cols <- grep("^SWC_", names(df), value = TRUE)

  df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      n_SHF = if (length(shf_cols) > 0) sum(!is.na(c_across(all_of(shf_cols)))) else NA_integer_,
      n_TS  = if (length(ts_cols)  > 0) sum(!is.na(c_across(all_of(ts_cols))))  else NA_integer_,
      n_SWC = if (length(swc_cols) > 0) sum(!is.na(c_across(all_of(swc_cols)))) else NA_integer_,
      SHF = {
        x <- if (length(shf_cols) > 0) c_across(all_of(shf_cols)) else numeric(0)
        if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      TS = {
        x <- if (length(ts_cols) > 0) c_across(all_of(ts_cols)) else numeric(0)
        if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      SWC = {
        x <- if (length(swc_cols) > 0) c_across(all_of(swc_cols)) else numeric(0)
        if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

build_rp_drivers <- function(bio_drivers, grant_hh = NULL) {
  drv <- bio_drivers %>%
    transmute(
      DateTime,
      Rg_bio      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Rg)),
      Tair_bio    = K_to_C_if_needed(Tair),
      RH_bio      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(RH)),
      P_bio_mm_30 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(P)) * 1000
    )

  if (!is.null(grant_hh)) {
    drv <- drv %>%
      left_join(
        grant_hh %>%
          transmute(
            DateTime,
            Rg_grant      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Rg_env_Wm2)),
            Tair_grant    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Tair_env_C)),
            RH_grant      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(RH_env_pct)),
            VPD_grant_kPa = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(VPD_env_kPa)),
            P_grant_mm_30 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pcpn_mm_30min))
          ),
        by = "DateTime"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Rg_raw = coalesce(Rg_bio, Rg_grant),
        Rg = case_when(
          is.na(Rg_raw) ~ NA_real_,
          Rg_raw < 0    ~ 0,
          Rg_raw > 1400 ~ NA_real_,
          TRUE          ~ Rg_raw
        ),
        Tair = coalesce(Tair_bio, Tair_grant),
        RH   = coalesce(RH_bio, RH_grant),
        P_mm_30 = coalesce(P_bio_mm_30, P_grant_mm_30),
        Rg_src   = if_else(!is.na(Rg_bio),   "biomet", if_else(!is.na(Rg_grant),   "grant", NA_character_)),
        Tair_src = if_else(!is.na(Tair_bio), "biomet", if_else(!is.na(Tair_grant), "grant", NA_character_)),
        RH_src   = if_else(!is.na(RH_bio),   "biomet", if_else(!is.na(RH_grant),   "grant", NA_character_)),
        VPD_calc_kPa = calc_vpd_kPa(Tair, RH)
      ) %>%
      select(DateTime, Rg, Tair, RH, VPD_calc_kPa, P_mm_30,
             Rg_src, Tair_src, RH_src, VPD_grant_kPa, Rg_raw)
  } else {
    drv <- drv %>%
      mutate(
        Rg_raw = Rg_bio,
        Rg = case_when(
          is.na(Rg_raw) ~ NA_real_,
          Rg_raw < 0    ~ 0,
          Rg_raw > 1400 ~ NA_real_,
          TRUE          ~ Rg_raw
        ),
        Tair = Tair_bio,
        RH   = RH_bio,
        P_mm_30 = P_bio_mm_30,
        Rg_src = "biomet",
        Tair_src = "biomet",
        RH_src = "biomet",
        VPD_calc_kPa = calc_vpd_kPa(Tair, RH),
        VPD_grant_kPa = NA_real_
      ) %>%
      select(DateTime, Rg, Tair, RH, VPD_calc_kPa, P_mm_30,
             Rg_src, Tair_src, RH_src, VPD_grant_kPa, Rg_raw)
  }

  drv
}

# ============================================================
# 9) BUILD REddyProc INPUT TABLES WITH DYNAMIC SCREENING
# ============================================================
build_rp_table <- function(full_df, site = "LD") {

  df <- full_df %>%
    left_join(rp_drivers, by = "DateTime") %>%
    mutate(
      Rg   = as.numeric(Rg),
      Tair = as.numeric(Tair),
      RH   = as.numeric(RH),

      VPD_eddy_kPa = {
        v <- Pa_to_kPa_if_needed(VPD_Pa)
        v[v < 0 | v > 8] <- NA_real_
        v
      },
      VPD = coalesce(VPD_eddy_kPa, VPD_calc_kPa),
      Ustar = as.numeric(ustar),

      NEE_raw = if_else(
        !is.na(co2_strg),
        as.numeric(co2_flux) + as.numeric(co2_strg),
        as.numeric(co2_flux)
      ),

      Date = as.Date(DateTime),
      GrowingSeason = Date >= gs_start & Date <= gs_end,
      WinterWindow  = month(DateTime) %in% c(1, 2, 3, 11, 12),

      is_night      = !is.na(Rg) & Rg < night_rg_thr,
      is_transition = !is.na(Rg) & Rg >= night_rg_thr & Rg < transition_rg_thr,
      is_daytime    = !is.na(Rg) & Rg >= 45,
      low_ustar     = !is.na(Ustar) & Ustar < ustar_review_thr,

      # The footprint-sector exclusion applies only to the LD orchard.
      flag_fetch_excluded = if (site == "LD") {
        !is.na(wind_dir) & (wind_dir < fetch_keep_min | wind_dir > fetch_keep_max)
      } else {
        FALSE
      },

      flag_bad_qc =
        !is.na(qc_co2_flux) & qc_co2_flux >= 3,

      # keep this as positive-only
      flag_impossible =
        !is.na(NEE_raw) & (NEE_raw > nee_max_global),

      # Review every winter-night value below -5 that survives automatic
      # screening and the earlier high-positive/large-negative reviews.
      flag_review_winter_neg_night_all =
        WinterWindow & is_night &
        !is.na(NEE_raw) &
        NEE_raw < winter_neg_night_remove,

      # Low-u* winter negatives remain automatic removals, matching 2023/2024.
      flag_remove_winter_neg_night =
        WinterWindow & is_night & low_ustar &
        !is.na(NEE_raw) & NEE_raw < winter_neg_night_remove,

      flag_review_winter_pos_night =
        WinterWindow & is_night & low_ustar &
        !is.na(NEE_raw) & NEE_raw > winter_pos_night_review,

      flag_review_winter_transition =
        WinterWindow & is_transition &
        !is.na(NEE_raw) & abs(NEE_raw) > 20,

      flag_review_signal =
        !is.na(signal_strength) & signal_strength < 50,

      # High positive nighttime values were reviewed manually rather than
      # automatically removed in the final 2025 workflow.
      flag_review_high_night =
        is_night & !is.na(NEE_raw) & NEE_raw > 50,

      flag_extreme_negative =
        !is.na(NEE_raw) &
        NEE_raw < nee_extreme_cutoff &
        (Rg < rg_low_cutoff | Ustar < ustar_low_cutoff),

      # Final negative-artifact rules recovered from the preserved 2025
      # REddyProc inputs and the confirmed 2024 workflow.
      NEE_lag  = lag(NEE_raw),
      NEE_lead = lead(NEE_raw),

      is_isolated_negative_spike =
        !is.na(NEE_raw) &
        !is.na(NEE_lag) &
        !is.na(NEE_lead) &
        NEE_raw < -40 &
        abs(NEE_raw - NEE_lag) > 20 &
        abs(NEE_raw - NEE_lead) > 20,

      flag_remove_large_negative =
        !is.na(NEE_raw) &
        NEE_raw < -60,

      flag_remove_negative_spike =
        !is.na(NEE_raw) &
        NEE_raw < -40 &
        is_isolated_negative_spike,

      flag_remove_lowlight_lowustar_negative =
        !is.na(NEE_raw) &
        !is.na(Rg) & Rg < 10 &
        !is.na(Ustar) & Ustar < 0.10 &
        NEE_raw < -30,

      flag_remove_negative_final =
        flag_remove_large_negative |
        flag_remove_negative_spike |
        flag_remove_lowlight_lowustar_negative,

      remove_nee =
        flag_fetch_excluded |
        flag_bad_qc |
        flag_impossible |
        flag_remove_winter_neg_night |
        flag_extreme_negative |
        flag_remove_negative_final,

      NEE = if_else(remove_nee, NA_real_, NEE_raw),

      # diagnostic copy of values that actually survive screening
      NEE_kept_for_diag = if_else(remove_nee, NA_real_, NEE_raw)
    ) %>%
    select(
      DateTime, NEE_raw, NEE, NEE_kept_for_diag,
      Rg, Tair, VPD, Ustar, wind_dir, signal_strength,
      qc_co2_flux,
      GrowingSeason, WinterWindow, is_night, is_transition, is_daytime, low_ustar,
      flag_fetch_excluded, flag_bad_qc, flag_impossible,
      flag_review_winter_neg_night_all,
      flag_remove_winter_neg_night, flag_review_winter_pos_night,
      flag_review_winter_transition, flag_review_signal,
      flag_review_high_night, flag_extreme_negative,
      NEE_lag, NEE_lead, is_isolated_negative_spike,
      flag_remove_large_negative, flag_remove_negative_spike,
      flag_remove_lowlight_lowustar_negative, flag_remove_negative_final,
      remove_nee
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(NEE_raw, NEE, NEE_kept_for_diag, Rg, Tair, VPD, Ustar),
             ~ if_else(.x %in% sentinel, NA_real_, .x)),
      Rg = if_else(!is.na(Rg) & Rg < 0, 0, Rg)
    ) %>%
    arrange(DateTime)

  make_full_year_time(year_use, tz_site) %>%
    left_join(df, by = "DateTime") %>%
    arrange(DateTime) %>%
    mutate(
      Year = year(DateTime),
      DoY  = yday(DateTime),
      Hour = hour(DateTime) + minute(DateTime) / 60
    )
}

# Build automatically screened tables first.

# ============================================================
# 9C) APPLY COMPLETED HIGH-POSITIVE + LARGE-NEGATIVE DECISIONS
# ============================================================
# These decisions are read from data/manual_review/2025 and are never altered.
standardize_review_file <- function(path, label) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Missing completed ", label, " manual-decision file: ", path)
  }

  raw <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  need_cols(raw, c("site", "DateTime", "decision", "reason"), label)

  raw <- raw %>%
    mutate(
      site = toupper(trimws(as.character(site))),
      decision = tolower(trimws(coalesce(as.character(decision), ""))),
      DateTime = parse_review_datetime(DateTime)
    )

  invalid <- raw %>%
    filter(
      !site %in% c("LD", "MD") |
        is.na(DateTime) |
        !decision %in% c("keep", "remove")
    )

  if (nrow(invalid) > 0) {
    stop(
      label, " contains ", nrow(invalid),
      " invalid or unfinished rows. Site must be LD/MD and decision must be keep/remove."
    )
  }

  duplicate_keys <- raw %>%
    count(site, DateTime, name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_keys) > 0) {
    stop("Duplicate site + DateTime keys found in ", label, ".")
  }

  raw
}

apply_manual_decisions <- function(rp_tbl, site_id, review_dir, neg_review_dir) {
  pos_path <- file.path(
    review_dir,
    paste0("HighPositiveReview_manual_decisions_TEMPLATE_", year_use, ".csv")
  )

  neg_path <- file.path(
    neg_review_dir,
    paste0("LargeNegativeReview_manual_decisions_TEMPLATE_", year_use, ".csv")
  )

  pos_decisions <- standardize_review_file(
    pos_path,
    "positive manual decisions"
  ) %>%
    filter(site == site_id) %>%
    transmute(
      DateTime,
      manual_decision_pos = decision,
      manual_reason_pos = reason,
      manual_remove_pos = decision == "remove"
    )

  neg_decisions <- standardize_review_file(
    neg_path,
    "negative manual decisions"
  ) %>%
    filter(site == site_id) %>%
    transmute(
      DateTime,
      manual_decision_neg = decision,
      manual_reason_neg = reason,
      manual_remove_neg = decision == "remove"
    )

  rp_tbl %>%
    left_join(pos_decisions, by = "DateTime") %>%
    left_join(neg_decisions, by = "DateTime") %>%
    mutate(
      remove_nee_auto = remove_nee,

      # Completed manual decisions override automatic screening.
      remove_nee_final = coalesce(
        manual_remove_neg,
        manual_remove_pos,
        remove_nee_auto
      ),

      NEE = if_else(remove_nee_final, NA_real_, NEE_raw),
      NEE_kept_for_diag = if_else(remove_nee_final, NA_real_, NEE_raw)
    )
}

review_dir <- high_positive_review_dir
neg_review_dir <- large_negative_review_dir

ld_rp <- apply_manual_decisions(ld_rp, "LD", review_dir, neg_review_dir)
md_rp <- apply_manual_decisions(md_rp, "MD", review_dir, neg_review_dir)

required_final_cols <- c(
  "remove_nee_auto",
  "remove_nee_final",

)

  }
}

# ============================================================
# 9C-2A) CREATE MULTIPANEL CONTEXT PLOTS
# ============================================================
# Each PDF page shows a 6-hour window (3 hours before and after)
# for NEE, radiation, u*, signal strength, QC, wind direction,
# and air temperature. Pages follow the candidate-table order.

make_winter_review_context_pdf <- function(
  candidates,
  rp_all,
  output_pdf,
  plot_index_path,
  review_label,
  review_threshold
) {

  candidates_indexed <- candidates %>%
    arrange(site, DateTime) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_page = row_number(),
      event_id = paste(
        site,
        review_label,
        format(DateTime, "%Y%m%d_%H%M", tz = tz_site),
        sep = "_"
      )
    )

  write_csv(
    candidates_indexed %>%
      select(
        plot_page, event_id, site, DateTime,
        NEE_raw, NEE_lag, NEE_lead,
        Rg, Tair, Ustar, qc_co2_flux,
        signal_strength, wind_dir
      ),
    plot_index_path
  )

  if (nrow(candidates_indexed) == 0) {
    message("No ", review_label, " candidates; no context PDF generated.")
    return(invisible(candidates_indexed))
  }

  grDevices::pdf(
    output_pdf,
    width = 11,
    height = 8.5,
    onefile = TRUE
  )

  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  metric_levels <- c(
    "NEE_raw", "Rg", "Ustar",
    "signal_strength", "qc_co2_flux",
    "wind_dir", "Tair"
  )

  metric_labels <- c(
    NEE_raw = "NEE_raw",
    Rg = "Rg",
    Ustar = "Ustar",
    signal_strength = "signal_strength",
    qc_co2_flux = "qc_co2_flux",
    wind_dir = "wind_dir",
    Tair = "Tair"
  )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidates_indexed))) {

    event_row <- candidates_indexed[i, ]
    this_site <- event_row$site
    this_time <- event_row$DateTime

    event_window <- rp_all %>%
      filter(
        site == this_site,
        DateTime >= this_time - hours(3),
        DateTime <= this_time + hours(3)
      ) %>%
      select(
        site, DateTime,
        NEE_raw, Rg, Ustar,
        signal_strength, qc_co2_flux,
        wind_dir, Tair
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = all_of(metric_levels),
        names_to = "metric",
        values_to = "value"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        metric = factor(
          metric,
          levels = metric_levels,
          labels = unname(metric_labels[metric_levels])
        ),
        is_candidate = DateTime == this_time
      )

    nee_guides <- tibble(
      metric = factor(
        c("NEE_raw", "NEE_raw"),
        levels = unname(metric_labels[metric_levels])
      ),
      yintercept = c(0, review_threshold),
      line_type = c("zero", "review threshold")
    )

    p <- ggplot(
      event_window,
      aes(x = DateTime, y = value)
    ) +
      geom_hline(
        data = nee_guides,
        aes(yintercept = yintercept, linetype = line_type),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linewidth = 0.35
      ) +
      geom_line(na.rm = TRUE, linewidth = 0.45) +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE, size = 1.2) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = as.numeric(this_time),
        linewidth = 0.55
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = event_window %>% filter(is_candidate),
        size = 3,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      facet_wrap(
        ~metric,
        ncol = 3,
        scales = "free_y"
      ) +
      scale_x_datetime(
        date_labels = "%b %d\n%I:%M %p",
        timezone = tz_site
      ) +
      scale_linetype_manual(
        values = c("zero" = 2, "review threshold" = 3),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          gsub("_", " ", review_label),
          " — candidate ",
          i,
          " of ",
          nrow(candidates_indexed),
          " (",
          this_site,
          ")"
        ),
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Candidate: ",
          format(
            this_time,
            "%Y-%m-%d %I:%M %p %Z",
            tz = tz_site
          ),
          " | NEE = ",
          round(event_row$NEE_raw, 2),
          " | previous = ",
          round(event_row$NEE_lag, 2),
          " | next = ",
          round(event_row$NEE_lead, 2)
        ),
        caption = paste0(
          "Eastern local time — ",
          tz_site,
          " | 3 hours before and after candidate"
        ),
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
      )

    print(p)
  }

  invisible(candidates_indexed)
}

# Ensure completed templates still match the current candidate sets.
check_candidate_keys <- function(candidates, decisions, label) {
  candidate_keys <- candidates %>% select(site, DateTime) %>% distinct()
  decision_keys <- decisions %>% select(site, DateTime) %>% distinct()

  missing_decisions <- anti_join(candidate_keys, decision_keys, by = c("site", "DateTime"))
  extra_decisions <- anti_join(decision_keys, candidate_keys, by = c("site", "DateTime"))

  if (nrow(missing_decisions) > 0 || nrow(extra_decisions) > 0) {
    stop(
      label, " template does not match the current candidate list. ",
      "Missing decisions: ", nrow(missing_decisions),
      "; extra decisions: ", nrow(extra_decisions), "."
    )
  }
}

  )

winter_pos_decisions <- winter_pos_raw %>%
  transmute(
    site,
    DateTime,
    winter_decision_pos = decision,
    winter_reason_pos = reason,
    winter_remove_pos = decision == "remove"
  )

apply_winter_decisions <- function(rp_tbl, site_id) {
  neg_site <- winter_neg_decisions %>%
    filter(site == site_id) %>%
    select(-site)

  pos_site <- winter_pos_decisions %>%
    filter(site == site_id) %>%
    select(-site)

  rp_tbl %>%
    left_join(neg_site, by = "DateTime") %>%
    left_join(pos_site, by = "DateTime") %>%
    mutate(
      remove_nee_final = coalesce(
        winter_remove_neg,
        winter_remove_pos,
        remove_nee_final
      ),
      NEE = if_else(remove_nee_final, NA_real_, NEE_raw),
      NEE_kept_for_diag = if_else(remove_nee_final, NA_real_, NEE_raw)
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 10) RUN REddyProc
# ============================================================
run_reddyproc_site <- function(rp_tbl, site_id, out_subdir) {

  proc_in <- rp_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      DateTime,
      Year,
      DoY,
      Hour,
      NEE   = as.numeric(NEE),
      Rg    = as.numeric(Rg),
      Tair  = as.numeric(Tair),
      VPD   = as.numeric(VPD),
      Ustar = as.numeric(Ustar)
    )

  EProc <- sEddyProc$new(
    site_id,
    proc_in,
    c("NEE", "Rg", "Tair", "VPD", "Ustar"),
    DTS = 48
  )

EProc$sSetLocationInfo(
  LatDeg = LatDeg,
  LongDeg = LongDeg,
  TimeZoneHour = TimeZoneHour
)

# Fix the bootstrap sequence so publication results are reproducible.
site_seed <- c(
  LD = 202501L,
  MD = 202502L
)

set.seed(site_seed[[site_id]])

EProc$sEstimateUstarScenarios(
  nSample = n_boot,
  probs = probs
)

EProc$sMDSGapFillUStarScens(
  "NEE",
  FillAll = FALSE
)

EProc$sMDSGapFill("Tair")

EProc$sMRFluxPartitionUStarScens()

  export <- EProc$sExportResults()

  write_csv(
    as_tibble(export),
    file.path(out_subdir, paste0(site_id, "_REddyProc_export_", year_use, ".csv"))
  )

  list(EProc = EProc, export = as_tibble(export))
}

ld_run <- run_reddyproc_site(ld_rp, "LD", file.path(out_dir, "LD"))
md_run <- run_reddyproc_site(md_rp, "MD", file.path(out_dir, "MD"))

# ============================================================
# 11) EXTRACT SCENARIO OUTPUTS
# ============================================================
pick_scen_col <- function(nm_vec, prefix, scen = scen_use) {
  out <- nm_vec[grepl(paste0("^", prefix, ".*", scen, "$"), nm_vec)]
  if (length(out) == 0) out <- nm_vec[grepl(paste0("^", prefix), nm_vec)]
  if (length(out) == 0) NA_character_ else out[1]
}

extract_fluxes <- function(export_tbl, rp_tbl, site, scen = scen_use) {

  nee_col  <- paste0("NEE_",  scen, "_f")
  gpp_col  <- paste0("GPP_",  scen, "_f")
  reco_col <- paste0("Reco_", scen)

  needed <- c(nee_col, gpp_col, reco_col)
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(export_tbl))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    stop("Missing expected export columns for ", site, ": ",
         paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  }

  cat("\n", site, " selected columns:\n", sep = "")
  cat("NEE : ", nee_col, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("GPP : ", gpp_col, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Reco: ", reco_col, "\n", sep = "")

  export_tbl %>%
    mutate(DateTime = rp_tbl$DateTime) %>%
    transmute(
      site = site,
      DateTime,
      Date = as.Date(DateTime),
      NEE_umol  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[nee_col]])),
      GPP_umol  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[gpp_col]])),
      Reco_umol = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[reco_col]]))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      NEE_gC_hh  = umolco2_to_gC_hh(NEE_umol),
      GPP_gC_hh  = umolco2_to_gC_hh(GPP_umol),
      Reco_gC_hh = umolco2_to_gC_hh(Reco_umol)
    )
}

md_flux_hh <- extract_fluxes(md_run$export, md_rp, "MD")

    NEE_gC_day  = if_else(cov_NEE  < min_coverage, NA_real_, NEE_gC_day),
    GPP_gC_day  = if_else(cov_GPP  < min_coverage, NA_real_, GPP_gC_day),
    Reco_gC_day = if_else(cov_Reco < min_coverage, NA_real_, Reco_gC_day)
  )

    ),
  md_full %>%
    transmute(
      site = "MD",
      DateTime,
      VPD_site_kPa = Pa_to_kPa_if_needed(VPD_Pa),
      RHpct = NA_real_,
      TA_C  = NA_real_,
      Rg_bio = NA_real_
    )
) %>%
  left_join(
    bio_drivers %>%
      transmute(
        DateTime,
        TA_C  = K_to_C_if_needed(Tair),
        RHpct = as.numeric(RH),
        Rg_bio = as.numeric(Rg)
      ),
    by = "DateTime",
    suffix = c("", ".bio")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    VPD_fallback_kPa = vpd_from_tair_rh_hPa(TA_C, RHpct) / 10,
    VPD_best_kPa     = coalesce(VPD_site_kPa, VPD_fallback_kPa),
    Date = as.Date(DateTime - minutes(30)),
    hr   = hour(DateTime),
    is_day    = !is.na(Rg_bio) & Rg_bio >= 10,
    is_midday = hr >= 11 & hr <= 15,
    VPD_day_kPa    = if_else(is_day,    VPD_best_kPa, NA_real_),
    VPD_midday_kPa = if_else(is_midday, VPD_best_kPa, NA_real_)
  )

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = site,

# ============================================================
# 15) LD Gstorage + ENERGY BALANCE (2024-style method)
# ============================================================
z_plate_m <- 0.05
rho_b     <- 1300
cp_solid  <- 800
rho_w     <- 1000
cp_w      <- 4186
max_abs_Gstor <- 200

calc_Gstorage <- function(DateTime, TS_K, SWC, z_m,
                          rho_b, cp_solid, rho_w, cp_w,
                          expected_dt = 1800, max_gap_mult = 2) {

  n <- length(DateTime)
  if (n < 3) return(rep(NA_real_, n))

  TS_K <- as.numeric(TS_K)
  SWC  <- as.numeric(SWC)

  med_ts <- suppressWarnings(median(TS_K, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(med_ts)) return(rep(NA_real_, n))
  if (med_ts < 150) TS_K <- TS_K + 273.15

  Cv <- rho_b * cp_solid + SWC * rho_w * cp_w

  dt_prev <- as.numeric(difftime(DateTime, dplyr::lag(DateTime), units = "secs"))
  dt_next <- as.numeric(difftime(dplyr::lead(DateTime), DateTime, units = "secs"))

  dT_prev <- TS_K - dplyr::lag(TS_K)
  dT_next <- dplyr::lead(TS_K) - TS_K

  dTdt <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  ok_center <- !is.na(dT_prev) & !is.na(dT_next) & !is.na(dt_prev) & !is.na(dt_next)
  dTdt[ok_center] <- 0.5 * (dT_prev[ok_center] / dt_prev[ok_center] +
                            dT_next[ok_center] / dt_next[ok_center])

  if (!is.na(dt_next[1]) && !is.na(dT_next[1])) dTdt[1] <- dT_next[1] / dt_next[1]
  if (!is.na(dt_prev[n]) && !is.na(dT_prev[n])) dTdt[n] <- dT_prev[n] / dt_prev[n]

  gap_limit <- expected_dt * max_gap_mult
  bad_gap <- (dt_prev > gap_limit) | (dt_next > gap_limit)
  dTdt[bad_gap] <- NA_real_

  Cv * z_m * dTdt
}

need_cols(bio_drivers, c("DateTime","SHF","TS","SWC"), "bio_drivers (for EB)")

eb_corr <- ld_full %>%
  left_join(
    bio_drivers %>%
      transmute(
        DateTime,
        Rg  = as.numeric(RG_1_1_1),
        Rn  = as.numeric(RN_1_1_1),
        Gp  = as.numeric(SHF),
        TS  = as.numeric(TS),
        SWC = as.numeric(SWC)
      ),
    by = "DateTime"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    DateTime, Rg, Rn, Gp, TS, SWC,
    H  = as.numeric(H),
    LE = as.numeric(LE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Rg, Rn, Gp, TS, SWC, H, LE), ~ ifelse(.x %in% sentinel, NA_real_, .x))
  ) %>%
  arrange(DateTime) %>%
  mutate(
    Gstor = calc_Gstorage(
      DateTime,
      TS_K = TS,
      SWC = SWC,
      z_m = z_plate_m,
      rho_b = rho_b,
      cp_solid = cp_solid,
      rho_w = rho_w,
      cp_w = cp_w
    ),
    Gstor = ifelse(!is.na(Gstor) & abs(Gstor) > max_abs_Gstor, NA_real_, Gstor),
    G0 = Gp + coalesce(Gstor, 0),
    avail_corr = Rn - G0,
    turb = H + LE
  )

write_csv(
  eb_corr,
  file.path(out_dir, "LD", paste0("LD_EB_table_with_Gstorage_", year_use, "_", run_tag, ".csv"))
)

eb_day <- eb_corr %>%

eb_midday_gs <- eb_corr %>%

    !is.na(Rg) & Rg > 300,
    hour(DateTime) >= 11, hour(DateTime) <= 15,
    as.Date(DateTime) >= gs_start, as.Date(DateTime) <= gs_end
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(turb), is.finite(avail_corr))

fit_if_possible <- function(df) if (nrow(df) < 50) NULL else lm(turb ~ avail_corr, data = df)

fit_day <- fit_if_possible(eb_day)
fit_mid <- fit_if_possible(eb_midday_gs)

summ_fit <- function(fit, label, n) {
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    tibble(
      window = label,
      n = n,
      slope = NA_real_,
      intercept = NA_real_,
      r2 = NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    tibble(
      window = label,
      n = n,
      slope = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
      intercept = unname(coef(fit)[1]),
      r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared
    )
  }
}

eb_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ_fit(fit_day, "Daytime (Rg>10)", nrow(eb_day)),
  summ_fit(fit_mid, "Midday GS (Rg>300, 11–15)", nrow(eb_midday_gs))
)

write_csv(

  file.path(out_dir, "LD", paste0("LD_energy_balance_storage_corrected_summary_", year_use, "_", run_tag, ".csv"))
)

plot_eb <- function(df, title, subtitle, out_png) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = avail_corr, y = turb)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Available energy (Rn - G0) [W m-2]",
      y = "Turbulent flux (H + LE) [W m-2]"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  ggsave(out_png, p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  p
}

  eb_day,
  paste0("LD Energy Balance (Daytime, storage-corrected) — ", year_use, " (", run_tag, ")"),
  "G0 = SHF plate + Gstorage (Cv*z*dT/dt)",
  file.path(diagnostic_figure_dir, "LD", paste0("LD_EB_day_storage_corrected_", year_use, "_", run_tag, ".png"))
)

)

# ----------------------------
calc_rand_sd_total <- function(full_df, rp_df, site_name) {
  full_df %>%
    transmute(
      DateTime,
      rand_err_co2_flux = as.numeric(rand_err_co2_flux)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      rp_df %>%
        transmute(DateTime, keep = !is.na(NEE)),
      by = "DateTime"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rand_err_gC_hh = umolco2_to_gC_hh(rand_err_co2_flux),
      Date = as.Date(DateTime),
      GrowingSeason = Date >= gs_start & Date <= gs_end
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      site = site_name,
      Year = year_use,
      NEE_SD_rand_gC_total =
        sqrt(sum((rand_err_gC_hh[keep & !is.na(rand_err_gC_hh)])^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      NEE_SD_rand_gC_GS =
        sqrt(sum((rand_err_gC_hh[keep & GrowingSeason & !is.na(rand_err_gC_hh)])^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
}

# ----------------------------
# 16d) u* threshold uncertainty using DAILY propagation
# ----------------------------
extract_scen_daily <- function(run_export, rp_tbl, site_name) {
  exp_tbl <- as_tibble(run_export) %>%
    mutate(
      DateTime = rp_tbl$DateTime,
      Date = as.Date(DateTime),
      GrowingSeason = Date >= gs_start & Date <= gs_end
    )

  scen_labels <- c("U05", "U50", "U95")

  map_dfr(scen_labels, function(sc) {
    nee_col <- paste0("NEE_", sc, "_f")

    if (!nee_col %in% names(exp_tbl)) {
      stop("Missing expected REddyProc scenario column: ", nee_col)
    }

    exp_tbl %>%
      transmute(
        site = site_name,
        Year = year_use,
        Date,
        GrowingSeason,
        ustar_scenario = sc,
        NEE_gC_hh = umolco2_to_gC_hh(as.numeric(.data[[nee_col]]))
      ) %>%
      group_by(site, Year, Date, GrowingSeason, ustar_scenario) %>%
      summarise(
        NEE_gC_day = sum(NEE_gC_hh, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })
}

  extract_scen_daily(ld_run$export, ld_rp, "LD"),
  extract_scen_daily(md_run$export, md_rp, "MD")

# ============================================================
# 18) SCREENING DIAGNOSTICS FOR 10% SPIKE DATA
# ============================================================

# Purpose:
#   - evaluate whether current NEE screening thresholds are reasonable
#   - use RAW NEE values (before filtering) for diagnostics
#   - inspect patterns by site, season, day/night, u*, and radiation

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 18a) BUILD DIAGNOSTIC TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_tbl <- bind_rows(
  ld_rp %>% mutate(site = "LD"),
  md_rp %>% mutate(site = "MD")
) %>%
  mutate(
    site = factor(site, levels = c("LD", "MD")),
    Date = as.Date(DateTime),
    Month = month(DateTime),
    Hour = hour(DateTime) + minute(DateTime) / 60,
    GrowingSeason = Date >= gs_start & Date <= gs_end,
    WinterWindow = Month %in% c(1, 2, 3, 11, 12),
    DayNight = case_when(
      !is.na(Rg) & Rg < 10  ~ "Night",
      !is.na(Rg) & Rg >= 10 ~ "Day",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    LightClass = case_when(
      !is.na(Rg) & Rg < 10 ~ "Rg < 10",
      !is.na(Rg) & Rg >= 10 & Rg < 50 ~ "10 ≤ Rg < 50",
      !is.na(Rg) & Rg >= 50 & Rg < 300 ~ "50 ≤ Rg < 300",
      !is.na(Rg) & Rg >= 300 ~ "Rg ≥ 300",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    SeasonClass = case_when(
      GrowingSeason ~ "Growing season",
      WinterWindow  ~ "Winter window",
      TRUE          ~ "Shoulder season"
    ),
    low_ustar_flag = !is.na(Ustar) & Ustar < ustar_review_thr
  )

write_csv(
  diag_tbl,
  file.path(out_dir, "compare", paste0("Screening_diagnostic_table_", year_use, "_10spike.csv"))
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 18b) OVERVIEW COUNTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_counts <- diag_tbl %>%
  group_by(site, SeasonClass, DayNight) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_nonmissing_NEEraw = sum(!is.na(NEE_raw)),
    n_low_ustar = sum(low_ustar_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_low_ustar = 100 * n_low_ustar / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  diag_counts,
  file.path(out_dir, "compare", paste0("Screening_diag_counts_", year_use, "_10spike.csv"))
)

print(diag_counts)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 18c) QUANTILE TABLE FOR NEE_raw
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_quantiles <- diag_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(NEE_raw), !is.na(DayNight)) %>%
  group_by(site, SeasonClass, DayNight) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min = min(NEE_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    p0.5 = quantile(NEE_raw, 0.005, na.rm = TRUE),
    p1   = quantile(NEE_raw, 0.01,  na.rm = TRUE),
    p5   = quantile(NEE_raw, 0.05,  na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(NEE_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    p95  = quantile(NEE_raw, 0.95,  na.rm = TRUE),
    p99  = quantile(NEE_raw, 0.99,  na.rm = TRUE),
    p99.5 = quantile(NEE_raw, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(NEE_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  diag_quantiles,
  file.path(out_dir, "compare", paste0("Screening_diag_quantiles_", year_use, "_10spike.csv"))
)

print(diag_quantiles)

candidate_threshold_counts <- diag_tbl %>%

    winter_night_lt_neg5 = sum(WinterWindow & DayNight == "Night" & low_ustar_flag & NEE_raw < -5, na.rm = TRUE),
    winter_night_lt_neg6 = sum(WinterWindow & DayNight == "Night" & low_ustar_flag & NEE_raw < -6, na.rm = TRUE),

    winter_night_gt_10 = sum(WinterWindow & DayNight == "Night" & low_ustar_flag & NEE_raw > 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    winter_night_gt_12 = sum(WinterWindow & DayNight == "Night" & low_ustar_flag & NEE_raw > 12, na.rm = TRUE),
    winter_night_gt_15 = sum(WinterWindow & DayNight == "Night" & low_ustar_flag & NEE_raw > 15, na.rm = TRUE),

    gs_day_lt_neg40 = sum(GrowingSeason & DayNight == "Day" & NEE_raw < -40, na.rm = TRUE),
    gs_day_lt_neg45 = sum(GrowingSeason & DayNight == "Day" & NEE_raw < -45, na.rm = TRUE),
    gs_day_lt_neg50 = sum(GrowingSeason & DayNight == "Day" & NEE_raw < -50, na.rm = TRUE),
    gs_day_lt_neg55 = sum(GrowingSeason & DayNight == "Day" & NEE_raw < -55, na.rm = TRUE),
    gs_day_lt_neg60 = sum(GrowingSeason & DayNight == "Day" & NEE_raw < -60, na.rm = TRUE),

    nongs_any_lt_neg25 = sum(!GrowingSeason & NEE_raw < -25, na.rm = TRUE),
    nongs_any_gt_80    = sum(!GrowingSeason & NEE_raw > 80,  na.rm = TRUE)
  )

write_csv(

diag_tbl %>%

# ============================================================
# RESULTS TABLE FOR 2025
# ============================================================

results_table_2025 <- final_summary %>%
  transmute(
    Year,
    Orchard = site,

    `NEE_Full-year` = NEE_gC_total,
    `Random NEE SD_Full-year` = NEE_SD_rand_gC_total,
    `u* Threshold NEE SD_Full-year` = NEE_SD_ustar_gC_total,
    `Total NEE SD_Full-year` = NEE_SD_total_gC_total,

    `NEE_Growing-season` = NEE_gC_GS,
    `Random NEE SD_Growing-season` = NEE_SD_rand_gC_GS,
    `u* Threshold NEE SD_Growing-season` = NEE_SD_ustar_gC_GS,
    `Total NEE SD_Growing-season` = NEE_SD_total_gC_GS
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Year, Orchard),
    names_to = c(".value", "Period"),
    names_sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    rp_summary %>%
      transmute(
        Year,
        Orchard = site,
        `Percent Gap-filled_Full-year` = pct_hh_modeled,
        `Percent Gap-filled_Growing-season` = pct_hh_GS_modeled
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -c(Year, Orchard),
        names_to = c(".value", "Period"),
        names_sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)"
      ) %>%
      rename(`% Gap-filled` = `Percent Gap-filled`),
    by = c("Year", "Orchard", "Period")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Days = case_when(
      Period == "Full-year" ~ if_else(leap_year(Year), 366L, 365L),
      Period == "Growing-season" ~ as.integer(gs_end - gs_start) + 1L
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Year, Orchard, Period, Days, NEE,
    `Random NEE SD`, `u* Threshold NEE SD`, `Total NEE SD`, `% Gap-filled`
  ) %>%
  arrange(Orchard, match(Period, c("Full-year", "Growing-season"))) %>%
  mutate(
    NEE = round(NEE, 0),
    `Random NEE SD` = round(`Random NEE SD`, 0),
    `u* Threshold NEE SD` = round(`u* Threshold NEE SD`, 0),
    `Total NEE SD` = round(`Total NEE SD`, 0),
    `% Gap-filled` = round(`% Gap-filled`, 0)
  )

print(results_table_2025, n = Inf)
```
